note: The one list both readers of a browser card's hosts are pinned to: Studio's hostsNamedIn and namesUncheckableAddress (packages/frontend/src/screens/studio/components/browserAutoStart.ts), which decide whether a card opens by itself, and the runtime's hosts_studio_reads and studio_cannot_check (packages/runtime-agent/src/jobs/browser_request.rs), which decide whether a turn with only that card keeps its words. A rule changed on one side and not the other fails a test on both. `hosts` is every host the text names, sorted; `uncheckable` is whether it names an address Studio can't compare with what the person read.
